quest.title: Destined Encounter
quest.description: Masrur at Port Ormos is currently worrying himself sick over a letter with an unclear address...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x625, Mora x25450, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait, you're that blond traveler who's on a journey to all corners of Teyvat, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who's asking...? Do you need something from us?

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: You bet I do! Phew, I was worried I wouldn't be able to find you! I have a letter for you, you see — it's from another outlander...

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: He was a crafty fellow, lemme tell you... Took advantage of a loophole in our mailing system by opting for Guaranteed Delivery then filling in the most obscure mailing address I've ever seen!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we are always on the road, so yeah, it's pretty tough to get mail to us unless we happen to go to the post office on a whim...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, um... what address did that person give you, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: Uh... he just wrote, "next to a small, white-haired talking fairy."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? So the address is Paimon!?

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: *sigh* Exactly, right? And if I'd failed to deliver the letter, I'd have been bound by regulation to compensate him...

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: Really, he got me good. I count myself very lucky that I ran into you here.

choices.text: Great. Well, lemme see this letter.

response.speaker: Masrur
response.text: Of course, here it is. All yours!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, Paimon wants to have a look, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kaeya, huh? So he's here in Sumeru... Hmm, now that Paimon thinks about it, "crafty" does describe him pretty well.

choices.text: Yeah. Can't say I'm hugely surprised.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: From what he wrote in the letter, it looks like he didn't think there was much chance of it reaching us...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, or maybe he's just being sneaky... Do you think he's making this sound like a miracle of fate so that we'd have to go meet up with him?

choices.text: Very scheming indeed...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, yeah, you're right. It's always nice to see old friends!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The letter says that he hangs out at Djafar Tavern every afternoon. Perhaps we should drop in on him then, huh?

choices.text: Well, no harm done. It'll be nice to catch up with him.
This is definitely Kaeya's style.
Lemme see this letter. I'm really curious who could've sent it...

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: This was a first for me. It's a good thing luck was on my side...

talks.objective: Go to Djafar Tavern and look for Kaeya

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: ...I'll have something I haven't tried yet, Boss.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: Um... Sorry, Sir, I'm afraid you've already tried every type of liquor we serve...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oh? Well then, just the bill, please. It's just as well, I suppose. I do have other matters to attend to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kaeya! You're really here! Paimon half thought you were playing some sort of prank on us...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Hey, Paimon, {NICKNAME}. Looks like the gods smile upon me after all. And come now, I wouldn't joke about wanting to see my good friends, haha...

choices.text: If you say so.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a second, you must be here on official business, right? What do you think you're doing, spending every afternoon drinking at the tavern? You itching for a lecture from Jean?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hahaha, not at all. The Acting Grand Master positively terrifies me. Why would I ever do anything that might displease her?

choices.text: Uh-huh... Very believable.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The truth is, I'm in Sumeru to learn about the alcohol industry here. So despite how it might look, I'm actually at Djafar Tavern for strictly business purposes.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Sumeru's spices are famous the world over, and it's long been rumored that this fine establishment was where a certain very popular spiced cocktail was invented.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: That's why the Knights sent me, their foremost expert in alcoholic beverages, to come and see if it is as good as the rumors say.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And how did that go?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: So far so good... I'm already in talks with some spice merchants in Port Ormos about some potential collaboration.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that does sound like a great business opportunity. Guess Dawn Winery and Master Diluc are gonna make a tidy sum from this one too, huh?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Well, let's not get ahead of ourselves... Whether this lucrative opportunity gets passed along to Dawn Winery or not depends on how nice I'm feeling... Hahaha.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Using your job to settle personal grievances isn't very knightly, Captain!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...I'm guessing you've been to Sumeru before?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oh? What makes you say that?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You came to Sumeru all on your own. So you must be quite familiar with the place.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Very sharp of you... I wouldn't say I'm familiar, though. I just came here on the sly once, when I was very young.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And? Do continue...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Heh... Do I have to? When I said we could talk about the old times, digging up my past wasn't exactly what I had in mind...

choices.text: Don't worry about it.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Well, alright, since you're so interested... Like I said, I was very young then. Dawn Winery had only just taken me in.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I overheard my adoptive father talk about sending a team of merchants to Sumeru during a business meeting.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'm sure you'll agree that everyone's curious about their roots on some level. And my roots... They're in Khaenri'ah, which is said to have been located deep underground somewhere near Sumeru.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Khaenri'ah...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: And so I stowed myself away amidst the cargo, and silently joined the merchant delegation on their trip to Sumeru...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: But it wasn't long before the merchant delegation received news that I'd gone missing. Their leader promptly found me, and before I knew it, my adoptive father was dragging me back home by the ear...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: It was a short-lived adventure. Sorry I don't have a more thrilling story for you, hehe...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Speaking of Khaenri'ah... How much do you know about it?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Honestly, not much. The only reason I knew that Khaenri'ah was near Sumeru is because I happened to read that in a book when I was young.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: My life had less and less to do with Khaenri'ah as I grew up, and so I started caring less as well.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I used to believe that I had inherited some sort of duty from my father...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: But then I began to wonder... Maybe my father left me in the peaceful land of Mondstadt for no other reason than simply to keep me alive...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: As well as ensuring that I'd be safely cut off from certain things... The thought that I might be able to actually live a happy life there must have been the icing on the cake.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: ...This is obviously all speculation. Simply put, I'm afraid that I'm not particularly in the know on this topic.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: These days, my surname, Alberich, is probably the only link to Khaenri'ah that I have left.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: ...One Death After Noon please, Boss.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Tell me... what do you know about the significance of that name, "Alberich"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: D—Dainsleif!?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Ah, you've decided to join us? I was wondering how long you planned on listening in. I believe I've seen you before in Mondstadt... Dainsleif, if I'm not mistaken?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: So you remember me. Then we are already acquainted, Kaeya Alberich... descendant of the Abyss Order's founder.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Abyss Order...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I take it that you weren't aware of this until now, Kaeya, or you wouldn't have been so forthcoming with your surname.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oh, my... that's quite a lot of baggage for a surname, isn't it? Though I must say, it does confirm an old suspicion of mine. I suppose that was why my father left me in Mondstadt after all...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I'm surprised that you take me at my word without the faintest hint of skepticism...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Well, perhaps what you told me just happens to answer some questions I carry in my memories. And, in any case... I recognize your eyes...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: You're a pure-blood Khaenri'ahn, aren't you?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Very clever. Forgive me for being direct, but I sincerely hope this new knowledge doesn't change anything. If you've already let go of your ties to the past... then keep it that way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kaeya... You're not involved with the Abyss Order in any way, are you...?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hey, hold on now. This conversation has taken a rather sudden turn for the deadly serious... and I'm afraid that as someone from Mondstadt, I'm not accustomed to this sort of atmosphere...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: So what if I know my ancestry? Do I strike you as the type who would be bound by that kind of thing?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Relax. I'll be just as delighted to hunt down the Abyss Order tomorrow as I have always been.

choices.text: I trust you, Kaeya.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Either way, looks like we're out of time. I've got a spice merchant to meet in a minute, so I'll leave the three of you to carry on the conversation without me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Well, alright then... You go do your thing, Kaeya.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: See you 'round. And Dainsleif, no need to listen in from the sidelines next time we meet. Let me buy you a drink.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Hmph...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You don't really trust him, do you, Dain? You're both from Khaenri'ah, but you get on like oil and water...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: The fact is, I still do not know him well. It would be meaningless for me to jump to conclusions.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: But can a person truly be unaffected by their ancestry? This remains to be seen.

choices.text: So, you said that an Alberich founded the Abyss Order?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: #Well, I suspect that they call your {M#sister}{F#brother} their {M#Princess}{F#Prince} precisely because there is a succession of sorts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, so if {M#she}{F#he} was the founder, {M#she}{F#he}'d be the {M#"Queen,"}{F#"King,"} right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So what do you plan to do here in Sumeru?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I mean to investigate the "Loom of Fate." Do you remember that name?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, the Abyss Order's evil plan! We learned about that back in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You've got a new lead?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Not new. Not exactly... My memories suffer from erosion, but while I was recovering my health recently, I suddenly remembered something...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: #Your {M#sister}{F#brother}... {M#she}{F#he} mentioned the "Loom of Fate" back when we traveled together.

choices.text: All the way back then?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Apparently so. I was also quite surprised when these memories tallied up. I recall that we were traveling to Sumeru when the matter was brought up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #So you're going to the place that {M#she}{F#he} mentioned back then?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Correct. At that time, they must have been introduced, in one way or another, to this concept. If I recall correctly, we were somewhere in Avidya Forest then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go! Maybe we'll discover some secret that's lain hidden for hundreds of years!

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: No. Now is not the time.

choices.text: Are you concerned about the Abyss Order?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: No, it's just...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I'm still waiting for my drink.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously...?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After Dain finishes his drink, you prepare to travel to Avidya Forest...

choices.text: Are we waiting for the perfect moment?
So that was already a thing several centuries ago?
I thought my sibling was the founder...
I think... I guess.
You don't have to go into great detail.
You? Terrified? I don't buy it.
We've missed you too.

talks.objective: Go to the place Dainsleif mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Wait... This place, it's... familiar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about it? It looks pretty normal to Paimon... Was it like this hundreds of years ago, too?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Yes. The forest has barely changed from how I remember it. There is very little human activity here, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Let's search the area and see what we can find.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this a field? It must belong to whoever owns that house over there...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it looks like it's been abandoned for a long time. You could be forgiven for thinking nothing was ever grown here... Or wait, maybe nothing ever WAS grown here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's an extinguished bonfire. Forest Rangers, perhaps?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like it's been ages since it was last lit. And clearly they put it out carefully to prevent a forest fire, too. That's responsible.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Nothing else stands out in this area. All that's left is that building. Come on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, we're just gonna go barging in? What if someone's home?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Unlikely. There are no signs of life in this area. We should be able to enter without incident.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you say so... Well, uh... you lead the way then, Dain. Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This bed looks pretty ordinary. Huh, there's nothing underneath it, either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What sort of person would wanna live here? It's so dark and damp... Can't be all that comfortable...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: I doubt that the appearance of those monsters was wholly random. There must be something nearby that attracted them.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: A Ley Line anomaly, perhaps? ...Hmm, but it seems to be more than that.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Okay — I'll go slightly further out to investigate any issues with the nearby Ley Lines. I might be a while. You should wait for me here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? You're going alone? You'd better not be trying to keep some secret from us!

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: ...Your suspicions are as banal as they are unwarranted. I merely think that this house should remain the focus of our investigation, and as such, someone ought to stay here and keep an eye on it.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Not to mention that if even Forest Rangers are capable of investigating Ley Lines, I will be more than able to handle it alone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, fair enough. Guess we'll just camp out here, then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good thing there's a bonfire over there. Let's make ourselves something to eat! All this running around has made Paimon real hungry.

talks.objective: Investigate the interior of the house

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey look, it's a bowl. Guess whoever used to live here liked to cook, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Can't you smell it? There's a heavy scent of medicinal herbs in here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, so it's a medicine bowl? ...*sniff* Hmm, seems you're right! You've got a good nose on you, Dain!

talks.objective: Investigate the interior of the house
Investigate the interior of the house

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's a box over here. Why don't we open it? Uh, and by "we," Paimon means you... Paimon's just scared that... whatever's inside might bite her fingertips off...

choices.text: What in the world is going through your head...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? This is... a mirror.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's broken, too. Was this a makeup box?

choices.text: It's just a regular mirror.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm. That's kinda... disappointing. Paimon was hoping we'd uncover some super big secret, especially after Dain talked this place up.

choices.text: It's just broken.
You sure are going places with your paranoia...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doesn't look like there's anything else worth our attention here. You sure we're in the right place, Dain?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: My memories are quite foggy, but my subconscious and instincts both assert that something once happened here.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: But, we'll exhaust ourselves if we search aimlessly... I hear noises outside. Let's go and check.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Noises? Is it...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: It's not much. Just some minor adversaries.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Paimon make a fire, and before you know it, night sets in.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh, your cooking is as good as ever! Even if there was no other reason, the food alone would be enough for Paimon to stick with you, hee-hee!

choices.text: Well, freeloading comes more naturally to you than most...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Changing the subject, Dain's taking forever! He said that there might be an issue with the nearby Ley Lines... How bad do you think it could be?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* We came together, but now it's back to just being the two of us again... Y'know, now that Paimon mentions it, we really have spent lots and lots of time together, haven't we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, so... don't take this the wrong way or anything, but, uh... d—do you ever get tired of Paimon being around?

choices.text: You make my day every day, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Aww, oh you, stop it! Now you're embarrassing Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm... So, um, next question... Don't know if it's okay to ask this, but Paimon's curious: What was it like traveling with your {M#sister}{F#brother}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The stars?

choices.text: We'd gaze at the stars, just like this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow...

choices.text: We traveled through the universe, always by each other's side...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is the first time we've ever been separated.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... Paimon understands. Being separated without even knowing the reason why... it's just terrible.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we'll find the truth together, sure as Paimon's your guide! Just you wait, Heavenly Principles! And you too, Teyvat!

choices.text: Just you wait, Heavenly Principles!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Y'know what? We've talked too long about this sad stuff. Let's talk about something happy instead! 'Cause if you're sad... Paimon will be too.

choices.text: Don't worry about it, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, alright. It's getting dark, so why don't you rest? Paimon will take first watch. Don't worry, no monster's gonna come and eat you up!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, that's a first. Paimon, not going to bed before me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, come on, don't say that... Paimon just wants to look after you for once.

choices.text: Alright.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nighty-night! Go on, shoo, off to sleep!

choices.text: Goodnight then, Paimon.
Thank you, Paimon.
And you too, Teyvat!
We saw all manner of hope and despair.
And we'd point at the planets we wanted to visit.
Not really. You're better than nothing, I guess.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, okay, fine. Paimon shoulda known you weren't gonna say anything nice.

choices.text: You're easy to please.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Hey, time to wake up. The sun has risen.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (...Dain?)

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: What a deep sleeper. You do know that we need to...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Hmm? Tear stains... You dreamed of your sibling last night, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: ...Alright. Rest here a bit longer then. I'll head into the forest to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Huh? Why're you going back into the forest...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: *yawn*...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hmm? How did I sleep till morning? Why didn't Paimon wake me up to switch shifts? ... Hang on a moment... Where IS Paimon, anyway?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Ah, I vaguely remember Dain coming over. Did Paimon go into the woods with him, seeing how I hadn't woken up yet?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Whatever the case, looks like it's just me here for now. Guess it's time to stretch my limbs and have a look around.)
(Clatter...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Wait, did that noise come from... inside the house?)

choices.text: Paimon, is that you?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (No reply... I should go inside and check.)

choices.text: Paimon, this isn't the time for hide-and-seek...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oho? What a coincidence, I just finished my talks with the Sumeru merchant. Didn't expect to bump into you again.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Shall we head back to the tavern for a drink? I'd like to chat with you about what happened during last year's Windblume Festival. Now that was really...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: ...Ah, I see you have other things to do with your time. Busy as ever, hmm? Alright then, remember to come see me at the Angel's Share when next you're in Mondstadt. Safe travels.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kaeya should be at Djafar Tavern right now. Let's go see him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so there really isn't anyone home... *cough* Ugh, this place is so dusty! Paimon bets no one's lived here in years!

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Investigate carefully. We mustn't miss a single detail.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Monsters! Wow, Dain's ears are sharp, just like his nose. He's in surprisingly good shape for a 500-year-old...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, although for someone who's as full of surprises as Dain, it's hardly a big deal... Anyway, let's beat up these monsters!
